title: Hyperion
features:
AIMBOT TAB
Core:

Aimbot (CamLock / MouseMove / ThirdPersonMouse)
Team Check, Alive Check, Wall Check
Toggle Mode (hold vs toggle)
Auto Retarget on kill
Sticky Aim with timer
Smoothing (Linear / EaseIn / EaseOut / EaseInOut / Spring)
Prediction (Velocity / Gravity) with adjustable strength
Lock Part selection (Head / HumanoidRootPart / UpperTorso / Torso / LowerTorso)
Target selection (ClosestToMouse / ClosestToCenter / LowestHealth / HighestHealth)
Max Distance limit
X/Y Offset

FOV:

FOV Circle (filled + transparent)
Adjustable radius, transparency
FOV color + locked color
Aim dot indicator

Triggerbot:

Auto-fire when crosshair is on target
Team Check, Wall Check
Adjustable delay and pixel threshold

Kill Effects:

4 styles: Skull, Cross, Expand, Dissolve
Adjustable size and color
Monitors all player health in real-time

ESP TAB
Visuals:

Box ESP (Square / Corner / Quad modes)
Filled Box option
Name tags (with display name support)
Distance tags
Health Bar (6 gradient styles: Smooth / Periwinkle / Emerald / Peach / Gold / Normal)
Player Tracers (Bottom / Center / Mouse origin)
Head Dots
Skeleton (R15 + R6 support)
Highlights (with fill + outline colors)
Show Health in Name, Show Tool
Team Check, Include NPCs
Rainbow Mode with speed control
Max ESP Distance

Colors & Sizes:

Individual colors for Box/Text, Tracers, Head Dot, Skeleton, Highlight Fill/Outline
Thickness sliders for everything
Font selection (UI / System / Plex / Monospace)

Chams & Tracers:

Viewmodel Chams (7 effects: Neon / Ghost / Metallic / Glass / Crystal / Wireframe / Normal)
Chams Rainbow with speed
Chams Outline with depth mode
Chams transparency control
Reset Viewmodel button
3D Bullet Tracers hooked to CastProjectileRequest
3 tracer modes: Beam, Lightning (animated smooth dancing bolt), Helix
Tracer material (Neon / ForceField / Glass)
Impact Flash with adjustable size
Tracer + Glow dual color system
Rainbow tracers
Adjustable thickness, glow size, fade time

MISC TAB
Movement:

Fly (WASD + Space/Shift)
Noclip
Fly Speed slider
Walk Speed slider

Crosshair:

4 styles: Classic, T-Style, Circle, Dot
Position (Mouse / Center)
Dynamic Spread (expands with movement)
Outline with color
Rainbow color
Rotation with speed
Center Dot (filled/unfilled, adjustable radius, color)
Inner Lines with size and gap
Full color customization

Skybox:

10 presets (Galaxy / Clouds / Dark / Red / Purple Nebula / Blue Sky / Space / Sunset / Pink Sky / Storm)
Auto Cycle through presets
Next Preset button
Custom skybox ID
Remove Sky
